author_prompt:
Author 8 DIFFERENT natural ecommerce customer-service dialogue families in en.
Batch 7; ensure at least four current turns classified as product_technical across this batch.
Each family has its OWN coherent history of 2, 4 or 6 short alternating user/assistant
messages, followed by 3 ALTERNATIVE current user turns, not three sequential turns.
Those alternatives differ in effective intent: retain vs replace, withdraw vs
continue, single goal vs concurrent goal, or resolved vs unresolved reference.
Include natural short answers where history matters. Vary old completed tasks,
hesitation, self-correction, indirect wording, topics and dialogue acts. General
and human-service requests must also occur as NEW goals, not only stale history.
Do not follow a repeated sentence template or substitute product nouns to create
new families. Avoid stereotyped 'information only, do not submit' repetition.
Invent broad everyday ecommerce situations; no copied benchmark or private data.
History plus current turn should fit 150 English words or 180 Chinese characters;
keep it compact but meaningful. No future replies or final conversation summaries.
Supply the correct label for each alternative according to the rubric.

families.scenario: Customer bought a smart doorbell and is having trouble with the mobile app connection.

messages.content: Hi, I got the smart doorbell yesterday and installed it, but the app keeps saying 'device offline'.
Sorry to hear that. Have you confirmed the doorbell is receiving power and your phone is on the same 2.4GHz Wi-Fi network?
Yes, power is fine and I switched to 2.4GHz. Still shows offline.
Could you try holding the reset button on the back for 10 seconds until you hear a chime, then re-pair it in the app?

variants.text: I did the reset and it paired, but now the live view is black. Is the camera lens covered by the mounting plate?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Actually, forget it. I'll just return this and get a different brand.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Thanks for the help. Also, do you know if this model works with Google Home?
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer ordered a desk lamp but received a floor lamp instead.

messages.content: My order #48291 arrived today but it's the wrong item — I ordered the desk lamp, got a floor lamp.
I'm sorry about the mix-up. Would you like a replacement desk lamp sent out, or a refund for the incorrect item?
I'd prefer a replacement, but I need it before Friday for my home office setup.
Let me check our warehouse stock and shipping options for you.

variants.text: Actually, on second thought, just process a refund instead. I'll buy from a local store.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Can you also tell me if the floor lamp I received is dimmable? I might keep it as a bonus.
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Wait, I need to double-check — is the replacement going to be the LED version or the older halogen one?
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer is asking about a coffee maker's water filter replacement cycle.

messages.content: How often should I change the water filter in the CM-500 coffee maker I bought last month?
The filter should be replaced every 60 days or after 40 brewing cycles, whichever comes first.
Okay, and where can I buy replacement filters? Are they on your site?
Yes, we carry the compatible CF-2 filters. They're listed under 'Accessories' on the product page.

variants.text: Great, I'll order two packs. By the way, is there a way to track my previous order that was delivered two weeks ago?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Hmm, but I've only brewed about 15 times in two months. Should I still change it at 60 days?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Perfect, thanks. Actually, can you connect me to a human agent? I have a complaint about the packaging quality.
variants.label: human_service

families.scenario: Customer's account was locked after multiple failed login attempts.

messages.content: I can't log in — it says my account is locked. I think I typed the wrong password too many times.
I can help with that. For security, could you verify the email address associated with your account?
It's j.martinez@example.com. I really need access because I have a pending order.
Thanks. I've sent a verification code to that email. Please share it here to unlock your account.

variants.text: I got the code — it's 482913. Please unlock my account now.
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Actually, never mind. I'll just create a new account instead of dealing with this.
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Hold on — before I unlock, can you tell me if my pending order #7731 has already shipped?
variants.label: order_logistics

families.scenario: Customer is comparing two laptop models for video editing.

messages.content: I'm torn between the Aero 15 and the SlimBook 14 for video editing. Which one handles 4K rendering better?
The Aero 15 has a dedicated GPU with 8GB VRAM, which gives noticeably faster 4K rendering. The SlimBook relies on integrated graphics.
What about battery life when just doing light browsing on the Aero?
The Aero 15 gets roughly 6-7 hours on light use, while the SlimBook can reach 11 hours.

variants.text: That settles it — I'll take the Aero. Can I use my store credit from the return I did last month?
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Does the Aero support external GPU enclosures if I want to upgrade later?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Actually, I realize I mostly edit on my desktop. Maybe I should just get the cheaper SlimBook for travel.
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer received a damaged ceramic vase and wants to resolve it.

messages.content: My vase from order #9021 arrived cracked. The box looked fine but the vase has a hairline crack.
I'm sorry about that. We can send a replacement or issue a full refund including shipping.
I'd like a replacement since it's a gift for my sister's wedding next month.
Understood. I'll arrange a replacement to ship out today. Would you like expedited shipping?

variants.text: Yes, please use expedited shipping. Also, is the replacement coming from the same warehouse as before?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Actually, my sister's wedding got postponed, so just refund me instead.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Wait — is the replacement vase going to be the same hand-painted pattern, or could it be a different batch?
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer is asking about a fitness tracker's water resistance rating.

messages.content: I just got the FitPulse 3 tracker. Can I wear it while swimming laps?
The FitPulse 3 is rated 5 ATM, so it's fine for swimming and shallow water activities.
What about saltwater or a hot tub? I go to the beach often.
Saltwater and chlorinated water are okay for short exposure, but we recommend rinsing it with fresh water afterward. Hot tubs above 40°C are not recommended.

variants.text: Got it, thanks. By the way, how do I get in touch with your support team by phone?
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: So if I wear it in the ocean for an hour, will the heart rate sensor still work accurately underwater?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Alright, I'll rinse it after beach trips. Actually, can I exchange this for the FitPulse Pro which has GPS?
variants.label: billing_refund

families.scenario: Customer ordered a bookshelf and is asking about assembly difficulty.

messages.content: I'm considering the Oakline 5-shelf bookcase. How hard is assembly? I'm not very handy.
Assembly takes about 45 minutes with the included hex key. All panels are pre-drilled and labeled A through F.
That doesn't sound too bad. Does it come with wall-anchoring hardware?
Yes, anti-tip brackets and screws are included in the box for safety.

variants.text: Perfect, I'll order it. Oh, and can you check if my last order from last week has shipped yet?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Actually, I just realized my ceiling is only 7 feet and this bookcase is 6.5 feet — will it fit through my doorways during assembly?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Thanks for the info. I think I'll just browse a bit more before deciding.
variants.label: general

messages.content: I just got the FitPulse 3 tracker. Can I wear it while swimming laps?
The FitPulse 3 is rated 5 ATM, so it's fine for swimming and shallow water activities.
What about saltwater or a hot tub? I go to the beach often.
Saltwater and chlorinated water are okay for short exposure, but we recommend rinsing it with fresh water afterward. Hot tubs above 40°C are not recommended.
